items.title: 4.1 Mustaqil force ka kiya kaam (work) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.1 with Figs. 4.1 to 4.4 (PDF 75-76).

blocks.text: Aam zindagi mein work (kaam) se murad jismani ya zehni mehnat hoti hai. Lekin Physics mein work do cheezon se mil kar banta hai: (i) force, aur (ii) displacement (jagah ki tabdeeli). Hum sab se aasan soorat se shuru karte hain, jab work ek constant (na badalne wali) force karti hai.

Maan lein ek cheez ko constant force F se kheencha ja raha hai, aur force cheez ko apni hi simt (direction) mein displacement d tak le jati hai. Is soorat mein work W ki tareef yeh hai: force F ki miqdar (magnitude) aur displacement d ki miqdar ka hasil-e-zarb (product, yani zarb ka jawab). Isay yun likhte hain:

Equation (4.1) batati hai ke agar displacement zero ho to koi work nahi hota, chahe kitni hi bari force lagayi jaye. Maslan deewar ko dhakelne se aap ke muscles thak jate hain, lekin deewar hilti nahi, is liye work zero hai (Fig. 4.1).

blocks.alt: Ek larka aage jhuk kar dono haathon se ooncha deewar dhakelta hai. Deewar ke oopar Force likha teer deewar ki taraf hai; deewar par Wall likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.1: Deewar dhakelta larka (kitab ki Figure 4.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Jism par lagai gayi force hamesha displacement ki simt mein nahi hoti, jaise Fig. 4.2 mein rassi tirchhi (at an angle) kheench rahi hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne likha hai “force may not always be in the direction of force”, yani force hamesha force ki simt mein nahi hoti, jo be-mani jumla hai. Sahi baat yeh hai ke force hamesha displacement ki simt mein nahi hoti; Fig. 4.2 mein rassi displacement d se zawiya (angle) θ par hai.

blocks.alt: Ek larka rassi se block kheenchta hai. Block shuru ki jagah A par aur phir daen taraf B par dikhaya gaya hai. Block se force ka teer F rassi ke saath ufqi (horizontal) displacement teer d se zawiya theta oopar jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.2: A se B tak kheenche block ke displacement d se zawiya theta par force F (kitab ki Figure 4.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Agar force F displacement d ke saath angle θ banaye to work = displacement ki simt mein force ka component (hissa) × displacement ki miqdar. Yani:

blocks.text_alt: W = (F cos θ) d = Fd cos θ   (4.2)

blocks.alt: Axes: F oopar aur d daen taraf. Vector F origin se d-axis ke oopar zawiya theta par shuru hota hai. Us ki nok se dashed lakeer d-axis par girti hai, aur origin se us nuqte tak d-axis ka teer F cos theta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.3: Displacement d ke saath force F ka component (hissa) F cos theta (kitab ki Figure 4.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Force F tirchhi hai, is liye us ka sirf woh hissa work karta hai jo d ki simt mein hai. F ki nok (tip) se seedhi lakeer neeche d-axis par girayein: origin se wahan tak ki lambai F cos θ hai. Isi liye W = (F cos θ) d.
Equation (4.3) batati hai ke work scalar quantity hai (us ki sirf miqdar hoti hai, simt nahi). Work ka unit joule (J) hai. Equation (4.1) se:

Jab constant force kisi faasle d tak lagti rahe to isay ek saada graph par dikhaya ja sakta hai (Fig. 4.4). Aam taur par faasla x-axis par aur force y-axis par lete hain. Force nahi badalti, is liye graph ek horizontal (leti hui) seedhi lakeer hai. Agar constant force F (newton) aur displacement d (metre) ek hi simt mein hon to work Fd (joule) hai. Fig. 4.4 mein rang wala hissa (shaded area) bhi Fd hai. Is liye force-displacement graph ke neeche ka area (raqba) constant force ka work batata hai. Agar force F displacement ki simt mein na ho to graph F cos θ aur d ke darmiyan banate hain.

blocks.alt: Graph: y-axis par Force aur x-axis par distance. Rangeen mustateel (rectangle) OPQR: O origin par, P y-axis par, Q R ke oopar, R x-axis par. QR ke saath dohra teer F us ki oonchai aur neeche dohra teer d OR ki lambai dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.4: Mustaqil force ka force-distance graph: mustateel OPQR (kitab ki Figure 4.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Force nahi badalti, is liye graph seedhi horizontal lakeer PQ hai. Rectangle ka area = oonchai × chaurai = F × d, aur yahi work hai.
Work ki tareef se yeh baatein nikalti hain:

items: Agar θ < 90° ho to work hota hai aur isay positive work kehte hain.
Agar θ = 90° ho to koi work nahi hota.
Agar θ > 90° ho to work negative kehlata hai.
Work ka SI unit N m hai, jise joule (J) kehte hain.

blocks.caption: Work ka sign (nishan)
header: F aur d ke darmiyan angle θ

blocks.prompt: Ek musafir suitcase ke strap ko zameen se 45° par 200 N force se kheench kar suitcase ko 50 m le jata hai. Kitna work hua (numerical problem 4.8)? Ek jism 5 N force se 10 m chalta hai aur work 25 J hai; force aur displacement ke darmiyan angle kya hai (MCQ 4.10)?
blocks.explanation: W = F d cos θ = 200 × 50 × cos 45° = 200 × 50 × 0.707 = 7071 J, taqreeban 7 kJ. Doosre sawal mein 25 = 5 × 10 × cos θ, to cos θ = 0.5 aur θ = 60°.

items: Work ke liye force aur displacement dono chahiye: W = Fd; angle par W = Fd cos θ = F · d. Work scalar hai, unit joule (1 J = 1 N m). Displacement zero to work zero (deewar dhakelna).
θ < 90° par work positive, θ = 90° par zero, θ > 90° par negative. Force-displacement graph ke neeche ka area work hai.
